 You are here: Home / News & Features / Audio / Bonesville Pregame Show Al Myatt & Kevin Monroe Bonesville Pregame Show
 November 13, 2026 By Bonesville Staff Leave a Comment 
 Join Al Myatt and Kevin Monroe for the Bonesville Pregame Show as they look ahead to East Carolina’s American Conference challenge at Charlotte. They break down the Pirates’ dramatic win over South Florida last Friday and preview the matchup between ECU and the 49ers at Jerry Richardson Stadium (Saturday, 1:00 p.m., ESPN+).
 Myatt and Monroe analyze the Pirates and their opponent ahead of kickoff each week. Seasoned by five decades of experience as a sports journalist, Myatt has been an anchor columnist for Bonesville since the site’s founding in 2001. Monroe, an ECU Hall of Famer who served a lengthy stint as color analyst for the Pirate Sports Network, is contributing to Bonesville for the 19th straight year.
